decision.observation: The gate's lower-right fitting (a drooping grey pipe on the right post at ~(0.71,0.45)) is at goose-beak height. The dirt path visibly continues north beyond the gate. The goose stands just south of the gate.
decision.hypothesis: In this game gates open by beaking the latch and pulling: a held right-button grab on the pipe latch followed by a walk south may swing the gate open.
decision.memory: Left-button 'drag' = walking; a held right-button control is required for a true grab-and-pull.
